description: React component for transforming API requests into cURL commands, including UI for editing the original request, triggering transformation, and displaying the transformed curl command.

methods.name: formatCurlCommand
methods.description: Formats request parts into a properly indented curl command string.

methods.name: handleTransform
methods.description: Handles the process of transforming the user-input JSON request into a curl command, including API call and error handling.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keypress event to trigger transformation on Cmd/Ctrl + Enter.
